user_story: As a user, I want to retrieve a single task by its ID so that I can view its full details.

positive.title: Retrieve task details with valid ID
steps: Send a GET request to the /tasks/{id} endpoint with a valid task ID.
Receive a 200 OK response with the task details in JSON format.
positive.expected_result: The response should contain the full details of the task with the specified ID.

negative.title: Attempt to retrieve task with non-existent ID
steps: Send a GET request to the /tasks/{id} endpoint with a non-existent task ID.
negative.expected_result: The system should return a 404 Not Found response indicating that the task does not exist.

negative.title: Attempt to retrieve task with invalid ID format
steps: Send a GET request to the /tasks/{id} endpoint with an invalid task ID format, such as a string or special characters.
negative.expected_result: The system should return a 400 Bad Request response indicating that the task ID is invalid.

edge.title: Retrieve task with the minimum valid ID value
steps: Send a GET request to the /tasks/{id} endpoint with the minimum valid task ID, such as '1' or '0' depending on the implementation.
edge.expected_result: The system should return a 200 OK response with the task details if the task exists.

edge.title: Retrieve task with the maximum valid ID value
steps: Send a GET request to the /tasks/{id} endpoint with the maximum possible task ID according to the system’s constraints.
edge.expected_result: The system should return a 200 OK response with the task details if the task exists, or it should return a 404 Not Found if it doesn't.
